entities.name: André Bolhuis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johan Henk André Bolhuis is a retired field hockey player from the Netherlands. He competed at the 1972 and 1976 Summer Olympics and finished in fourth place in both Games. He was the Olympic flag bearer for the Netherlands in 1976.
